modern: Always run by the short way; and the short way is the natural one: so say and do everything in keeping with the soundest reason. For such a purpose frees a man from trouble, and conflict, and all scheming and showy display.
original: Always run to the short way; and the short way is the natural: accordingly say and do everything in conformity with the soundest reason. For such a purpose frees a man from trouble, and warfare, and all artifice and ostentatious display.
